text: Last year I have visited London with my class. We stayed in a hotel in the river. The museums were interested and free. I would like go back one day.

Nowadays many people work from home. This have both advantages and disadvantage. Workers save time because they do not need travel.
On the other hand, they can feel lonely.
My favourite sport is the tennis. I play it since I was ten. My coach say that I am good in it.
